Perth, Australia2516 contributions

When u just miss Japan and need a fix
Sep 2024 • Solo
This place was a 2 min walk from my hotel. I was hungry and tired and sick of the beeping of the bikes all around me. I needed some decent food and some sleep and found myself here. I’m yet to eat Japanese anywhere and not enjoy it. This place did not disappoint. I ordered the bonsai roll (nice but I found a speck of shell), Vega tempura (yum!), Tom yum soup (sweeter than normal and loaded with onion which I picked out but was really yum) and chicken panko. All dishes were really nice. It’s a little difficult to find this place. You need to go up stairs to what looks like a deserted building to catch the lift to the signed door. You can’t miss it. The only disappointment were both young waitresses seemed rather sour and sad, the older one of the two moreso. No real warmth or smiles. Fairly off putting for customers and not at all how Japanese hosts normally are. This also made it difficult ultimately to get their attention. The restaurant has a nice vibe with customers quite chatty, ambient lighting and was clean. Would I recommend - yes. Would I come back - yes. Am I full - yes!
